theme: 3 terms on quick actions on a row: hold a finger, swipe sideways, and the small menu

terms.definition: A gesture where the user holds a finger on the screen for a moment.
terms.example: A Long Press on the photo opens the preview.

terms.definition: A button that appears when the user swipes a table row sideways.
terms.example: Add a Swipe Action to delete a note.

terms.definition: A small menu of actions that appears after a long press on an item.
terms.example: Put copy and share in a Context Menu.

video.title: Long Press, Swipe Action & Context Menu | Day 124
video.description:
Learn to explain how users trigger quick actions in an iOS list: Long Press, Swipe Action & Context Menu, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Long Press - A gesture where the user holds a finger on the screen for a moment.
Swipe Action - A button that appears when the user swipes a table row sideways.
Context Menu - A small menu of actions that appears after a long press on an item.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 124 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Long Press, Swipe Action & Context Menu | Day 124
landscape.description:
Explain Long Press, Swipe Action & Context Menu in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
롱 프레스, 스와이프 액션, 컨텍스트 메뉴 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Long Press - A gesture where the user holds a finger on the screen for a moment.
한국어: 롱 프레스: 화면에 손가락을 잠시 대고 있는 제스처

Swipe Action - A button that appears when the user swipes a table row sideways.
한국어: 스와이프 액션: 테이블 행을 옆으로 밀면 나타나는 버튼

Context Menu - A small menu of actions that appears after a long press on an item.
한국어: 컨텍스트 메뉴: 항목을 길게 누르면 나타나는 작은 동작 메뉴

In this video, Mina and Jake add quick actions to each note row, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

dialogue.title: Quick actions on a row

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, users want quick actions on each note row.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Swipe Action for delete. It appears when the row is swiped sideways.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Context Menu. It appears after a Long Press.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long should the Long Press be?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The default is fine. Do not change it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I created a menu with `UIMenu`, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. The Context Menu has two actions, Copy and Share.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should delete be in the Context Menu too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, but also keep the Swipe Action. Many users swipe first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are two ways to delete confusing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not really. Both are standard iOS behavior.
A Long Press opens the quick actions.
